question: Which Harappan site shows evidence of sophisticated water management with reservoirs?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Dholavira**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Dholavira**, located in the **Kutch district of Gujarat**, is one of the most prominent archaeological sites of the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
• This site is particularly noted for its **sophisticated water management system**, which included a series of **reservoirs, drains, and channels**
